description: What changed in the ranking since a date, and why: the open tickets by priority (value / cost) then and now, and the tickets with a change of their own, with their rank then and now and the reasons (new, done, reopened, re-scored with the scores from and to, now blocked by a ticket, no longer blocked because the blocker is done). Tickets that only moved because others did are counted as shifted. The scores then come from the revisions, done from the tag changes; weights, relations removed since and the scores of deleted tickets aren't in the history, so deleted tickets are listed by title only. Default since: 7 days ago.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp (default: 7 days ago)

name: report_changes
